Disclaimer_Body: PCEdit edits Planet Crafter save files directly, and a bad edit can corrupt a save and lose progress. PCEdit copies your save aside before it first writes to it, but treat that as a safety net rather than a substitute: keep your own backup as well. This software is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.
Disclaimer_ShortNotice: Editing can corrupt a save. Back up your file first — use at your own risk.
About_Tagline: A save-file editor for The Planet Crafter.
Quit_DiscardBody: Closing PCEdit now discards your unsaved edits. The save file on disk is unchanged.
Overview_AttentionOverCapacity: Containers holding more items than their size: {0}. An unmodded game never does this; it is typical of an inventory-stacking mod, and the game may stutter with a save like this.
Overview_AttentionNearLoadLimit: Containers close to the game's limit of 8,000 items each: {0}. Items past that limit are lost when the game loads the save.
Overview_AttentionShowA11y: Show the containers that need attention on the Inventories page
Overview_AttentionRepairA11y: Repair the over-full containers into a new copy of the save
Repair_Intro: Removes the items beyond what each container can hold, starting with the last ones listed, and writes the result to a new save file. The save you opened is not changed.
Repair_KeepA11y: Keep at most this many times each container's size, from 1 to 100
Repair_KeepHint: 1 keeps exactly what an unmodded game allows. No container keeps more than 7,200 items, under the game's load limit.
Repair_Nothing: Nothing to remove at this setting.
Repair_UnsavedChanges: Save your other changes first. If writing the repaired copy failed, PCEdit would reopen the original file to undo the repair, and those changes would be lost.
Repair_Done: Items removed: {0}. The repaired copy is saved as {1} and is now open; the original save is unchanged.
Repair_Failed: The repaired copy could not be written. Nothing was changed: the original save is open again.

Inventories_FillOverFullHelp: Holds {0} items in {1} slots. An unmodded game never fills a container past its size; this is typical of an inventory-stacking mod.
Inventories_FillNearLoadLimitHelp: Holds {0} items. The game loads at most 8,000 items into one inventory and silently drops the rest.
Inventories_MoveStackA11y: Move one {0}, from a stack of {1}, to another inventory

Teleport_MultiplayerNote: Changes apply to the selected player only. For a player who is not the game's host, edit while they are offline and check the result in-game.
About_SaveLocationsHeading: Where the game keeps your saves
About_SaveLocationsNote: Xbox names each save with a random string that changes every time it is written. On Linux, replace ~/.steam/steam with your Steam library folder if the game lives on another drive.

About_BackupsNote: The first time PCEdit saves a file after you open it, the original is copied here first. The five most recent copies of each save are kept.
